long_biography.plain_text:
Woodland Heights links several of Thomas Stuart Holderby's apartment projects across North Carolina. Communities carrying the name were developed in Greensboro and Reidsville, while Thomas Estates and Rocky River broadened the portfolio into other local markets. The emphasis was regional multifamily development, with individual schemes ranging from apartment buildings to townhomes.

Holderby operated through TSH Development Company, a North Carolina business formed in 2008. As manager, he signed the company's expansion into Georgia and served as its named representative in the regional builders' association. TSH later undertook new apartment and townhome construction in Lexington, extending an earlier project footprint that included Sanford and Concord. His role combined company management with direct responsibility for property development.

uncertainties.detail: Independent records use the forms Thomas Stuart Holderby, Thomas S. Holderby, Thomas Holderby and Tom Holderby. The exact full name, middle initial, company, North Carolina geography and matching telephone number resolve these variants to the same person; unrelated Holderby records outside this chain were excluded.

One 2024 federal record lists Holderby's occupation as retired, but 2025 municipal permits identify TSH on active construction and 2026 regional reporting describes Holderby pursuing another development. The dossier therefore avoids a retirement claim and treats real estate as his current durable primary industry.

The public record shows Holderby building and operating property companies and projects but does not document his initial capital, early financial support or any transfer of core assets. The broad Self-made classification is retained at 80 rather than assigning an independent-start or advantaged-start subtype.

The owner-context source describes Holderby as TSH Development's founder, but the stronger state filing establishes him as manager rather than explicitly as founder. The dossier therefore uses Operator and does not propose a founder title.

No strong public source located in focused research established Holderby's birth date or place of birth. People-search and voter-aggregation pages were rejected as final evidence, so no birth field is proposed.

No personal LinkedIn, Instagram or personal website cleared the exact-person verification threshold. No official TSH Development website with a direct Holderby leadership link was found, and the builders' association directory was not misclassified as a company website.

Private addresses, family information, political activity, contribution details, legal matters, allegations, controversy, volatile project values, future site plans, net-worth estimates and all vessel material are excluded from both biographies.
